attestations.text: SHIH K'o-fa 史可法 (T. 憲之, H. 道鄰), d. 1645, Ming loyalist general, was a native of Hsiang-fu, Honan. Passing his chin-shih examination in 1628, he was appointed police magistrate of Sian, Shensi, where he gained a high reputation for administrative talent in both civil and military affairs.
